name: roblox-dev
description: Takes any Roblox game to the next level, at any stage: one main skill for planning and building a whole game, plus 12 focused skills (level-up audit, retention, monetization, UI, VFX and audio, maps and lighting, Blender models and animation, gameplay systems, debugging, performance, security and data, growth) that trigger on plain phrases like "the VFX is bad" or "my game is laggy".
